processDisclosure.actualEvent: During the final batched source read, a missing binary-display guard decoded these two public fixture inputs as UTF-8 with replacement and emitted the resulting certificate-bearing bytes into the internal tool output. This violated the instruction to avoid certificate payload output. The trace was preserved and the parent was informed immediately. No claim of fully compliant payload handling is made.
processDisclosure.subsequentStructureEvidence: Both exact input hashes were verified. Definite-length PFX v3 parsing shows outer Data, one AuthenticatedSafe Data, one X.509 certBag OID 1.2.840.113549.1.12.10.1.3 and no other SafeBag. The only readable bag is a public certificate with RSA public-key OID and 3072-bit modulus and RSA signature OID. This conclusion comes from structure, not filenames. No private-key bag or decrypted private data was observed in these two inputs.
